dedupe_keys.name: clean water supply coverage in phnom penh and the surrounding area

description: Clean water supply coverage in Phnom Penh and the surrounding area is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. The dataset shows about the coverage of clean water supplied by Phnom Penh Water Supply Authority (PPWSA) in Phnom Penh and the surrounding areas for the current situation and the future in 2020. Nowadays, the PPWSA covers 13 district but the coverage areas of 9 districts are approximately from 60 to 65%. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are SDG6 Clean Water and Sanitation, Water and sanitation, Water resources. It offers 6 resource(s) in geojson, jpeg, kml, shp, wms. The portal shows 2021-04-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
